chapter.verse: Pasian aw, nangma thutang kumpipa hilh in la, nangma thuman kumpi tapa hilh in!
Amah in thumanna tawh na mite tungah thu khen hen la, na mizawngte’ tungah thutan’na tawh thu khen ta hen.
Mualliante leh mualneute in thumanna tawh na mite’ adingin nopna puak ta hen!
Amah in mizawngte’ ading thu khen hen la, mi cimawhte suahtakna pia-in, mi nengniamte sucip ta hen!
Ni leh kha a om lai teng, khang tawntungin amah hing ta hen!
Amah, pawn lak lopa tunga guah kia leh lei a kawtsak guahzu tawh kibang ta hen!
Ama hun sungin thumanna pung hen la, khapi a bei mateng nopna om ta hen!
Ama ukna in tuipi khat pan tuipi khat, Gunpi panin leimong dongin om ta hen!
Ama galte a mai-ah kunsuk uh hen la, amah langpangte in leivui liak ta uh hen!
Tarshis kumpite leh tuikulh neu-a kumpite in ama tungah siah pia uh hen la, Sheba leh Seba kumpite in letsong puak ta uh hen!
Kumpi khempeuh ama mai-ah boksuk uh hen la, minam khempeuh in ama na sem ta uh hen!
Bang hang hiam cih leh mi cimawh mi in a koh ciangin honkhia a, a zawng mi leh huh ding nei lo mi honkhia hi.
Amah in a thakiam mi leh a cimawh mite hehpih a, mi cimawhte’ nuntakna hon hi.
Amah in amaute pammaih sa ahih manin nen’niamna leh ngong hihna panin amaute tankhia hi.
Amah khan’sau hen la, Sheba gam-a khamte ama tungah kipia ta hen! Ama adingin thu kingetsak tawntung hen la, sun thapai-in ama adingin thupha kingetsak ta hen!
Gam sungah an tampi piang hen la, mualliante dawn-ah dim mema-in Lebanon gam sung bang hen la, gam lak-a lopate bangin khuapite sung panin mite pung ta uh hen!
Ama min kip tawntung hen la, ni a om lai teng a minthan’na kip suak hen! Ama hangin mite in thupha ngah hen la, minam khempeuh in amah pen thupha ngahpa, ci ta uh hen!
Nalamdangte a bawl amah bek ahi, Israel Pasian, Topa in thupha ngah ta hen.
A minthang ama min in thupha ngah tawntung hen la, ama minthan’na in leitung khempeuh dim ta hen! Amen, Amen.
Jessi’ tapa David’ thungetnate bei ta hi.
